messages:
carla (Acme Sec): Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. A few quick follow-ups we need to close for our procurement/security team: 1) Can you confirm how RBAC maps to our org/tenant model when we use Dedicated vs Hosted? 2) Where do KMS access events show up in your audit logs and can we get an export sample? 3) For key rotation, what evidence can you provide that shows rotation + change control was applied (who approved, when, and which KMS key versions were used)?

alice (Eng-Security): Hi @carla, great questions. Quick answers up front: RBAC is scoped per-tenant in Dedicated, and in Hosted we provide tenant-isolation via metadata + customer-scoped service accounts. We'll send the mapping doc. Audit events for KMS ops are emitted to our centralized audit log (immutable stream) and also forwarded to customer-configurable destinations (S3, GCS, or SIEM).

ben (Solutions Eng): For the RBAC mapping, the concrete model is: 

```
RoleBinding {
  tenant_id: string,
  role_id: string,
  principal: service_account | user | org_group,
  scope: {dataset, model, deployment}
}
```

In Dedicated the RoleBinding is stored in the tenant control-plane and enforced in the runtime. In Hosted we enforce a tenant_id claim in the request token and map to the same RoleBinding rules.

alice (Eng-Security): For KMS audit exports, here's an example of the log lines we emit (redacted):

```
time=2025-11-12T14:03:22Z level=info event=kms.Decrypt key_id=proj-prod-kms-key-01 principal=svc-redwood-runtime action=Decrypt result=success request_id=abc123
```

We can provide a 7-day sample export in NDJSON with request_id, key_id (redacted or full on NDA), principal, action, result, and trace_id. We also include a signed manifest to show immutability.

carla (Acme Sec): That sample log looks good. On rotation evidence we need: the rotation ticket ID, approval audit (who approved), and post-rotation verification that old key material is not used. Do you publish KMS key version history?

alice (Eng-Security): Yes. Our rotation playbook records a ticket in our change system (linkable) and we store an audit proof bundle that contains: rotation_ticket_id, approver_ids, rotation_timestamp, previous_key_version (fingerprint), new_key_version (fingerprint), and verification run results. We can provide that bundle over the secure evidence drop for auditors. Typical bundle filename: evidence_rotation_<ticket>.tar.gz (SHA256 checksum included).

dana (Compliance): Note: for enterprise contracts we require proof that rotation was done within stated SLAs and that KMS key material had no access by third-parties post-rotation. Please ensure the bundle includes iam_bindings and a signed statement from platform ops.

ben (Solutions Eng): We'll namespace the artifacts by customer and environment and redact principals if needed. For sensitive requests we do a KCV (key-confirmation value) exchange: we provide a KCV fingerprint that the customer verifies against their record.

carla (Acme Sec): One more: vulnerability triage — last week your scanner flagged a transient CVE in one of the runtime libs. We need remediation evidence and whether any customer data was exposed during the window.

alice (Eng-Security): Good call. That was CVE-2025-0147 in dependency foo-bar, patched in runtime 3.1.4. Timeline we have: detection 2025-02-01, patch build 2025-02-02, canary deploy 2025-02-03, full rollout 2025-02-04. No customer data exposure — we traced requests and validated no abnormal access to KV caches. We'll provide the vuln triage ticket, patch PR, and the rollout canary logs (trace IDs).

carla (Acme Sec): Perfect. Can you also include a short one-page summary for our auditors? They like a human-readable timeline + artifacts list.

alice (Eng-Security): Will do. We'll assemble: RBAC mapping doc, KMS audit sample (NDJSON), rotation evidence bundle, vuln triage packet, and a one-page timeline summary. Expect a secure share link by EOD. @ben can you prepare the RBAC mapping and rotation bundle?

ben (Solutions Eng): On it. I'll prepare a redacted sample and link the change ticket. ETA 6 hours.

deploy-bot: Uploaded artifact: secure://evidence/2174001111/acme-evidence-v1.tar.gz (expires in 7 days) :lock: 

carla (Acme Sec): Received, thanks. I'll confirm with our audit team and follow up if they want more detail. Appreciate the rapid responses :thumbsup:

alice (Eng-Security): Thanks everyone. Tagging this thread as actioned; we'll keep the evidence in the secure share and open a follow-up thread if auditors request deeper forensics.
